hold_line.description: Nobody moves. Worth more the more wall is already standing on your stretch.

call_others.description: You shout, and the ones who know you by name answer.

show_watch.description: The torch runs along the top of the wall. Worth a great deal if there were people on watch last night; next to nothing if there weren't.

half_and_half.description: Nobody puts down the trowel to pick up the spear. Everyone does both at once, and that is the part they weren't expecting.
